## [Reducto API](https://docs.reducto.ai/quickstart)

For developers building automated pipelines. Available in Python, Node.js, Go, and REST, with Studio for visual pipeline building.

![](https://docs.reducto.ai/brand/parse.webp)

## [Reducto Office](https://docs.reducto.ai/office)

Build editing, redlining and conversion of .docx, .pptx and .xlsx into your own product with the Reducto Office SDK. Or try the hosted editor, where you and your agent edit the same file live.

![](https://docs.reducto.ai/brand/slides.webp)

[.docx](https://docs.reducto.ai/office#sdk-packages)[.pptx](https://docs.reducto.ai/office#sdk-packages)[.xlsx](https://docs.reducto.ai/office#sdk-packages)

[SDK overview](https://docs.reducto.ai/office)
